title: Scaffold Handoff Bucket
description: Provisions the multi-job diagnostic incident structure on GCS (BUCKET_STRUCTURE.md directory dictionary, support case link). Never pre-creates empty directory markers (.keep), manifests, READMEs or failure tables; directories in GCS are created on-demand as real files are uploaded. Requires an explicit bucket.

storage_key.description: Storage key (support case number or key)

bucket.description: Target GCS bucket name (e.g. example-debug-bucket or destination bucket)
